Name: Splitscreen Improved
Author: gaussfire
Description:
[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Features[/size]
[b]Splitscreen Layouts:[/b] Adds customizable splitscreen layouts to adjust where each player's screen is positioned.
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKLsy9l.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]
[b]Splitscreen Music Fix:[/b] Fixes issue with splitscreen/local co-op music not playing & suddenly stopping. (Not a perfect fix, but works much better than before)

[b]HUD Tweaks:[/b] Adjusts how various UI elements are displayed to work better with splitscreen.
 - Chat messages offset from toolbar, so they do not block the toolbar from being visible:[spoiler]BEFORE:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9t8g9qC.png[/img]

AFTER:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8HABqC3.png[/img]
[/spoiler]
 - Buff icons offset from toolbar, so they do not block the toolbar from being visible:[spoiler]BEFORE:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9tfhajt.png[/img]﻿

AFTER:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XeZMlxy.png[/img]﻿
[/spoiler]
[b]Show Player Name In Summary:[/b] Shows the player name banner in end-of-day shipping summary and level up menus. This makes it easier to distinguish each player's screen; for example, to avoid unintended profession choices (speaking from personal experience!).
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sTp58Od.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Supports single player, split-screen local multiplayer, and online multiplayer. All changes are client-side, so there are no compatibility issues when playing online multiplayer.
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for in-game config editing.
[/list]
Source on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/alanperrow/StardewModding/tree/master/SplitscreenImproved]Source[/url]
